about: Every record the ruling of 2026-11-07 15:16 ('the certified count wins') touched, against 96a1ff5: each joined statewide question whose state page prints its statewide totals (data/measure/statewide-filed-local.json, state_total). Where the state marks them certified, they are the record's counts ('counts_used': 'state'); where it does not, MEDSL's stand ('why_not'). Every other record of every file is unchanged, the stamps apart.

records.title: Issue No. 1: Proposing An Amendment To The Arkansas Constitution Concerning The Terms, Election, And Eligibility Of Elected Officials
records.why_not: the Secretary of State's table 'Initiatives and Amendments, 1938-2018' prints each issue's statewide yes and no with no word certified or official

p_before.not_computed: Ark. Const. art. 19, §22: text reads 'majority of the electors voting at such election'; the base (ballots on the amendment, or all ballots at the election) is not stated here. Amendment 7 states the initiative rule differently (see next object): the threshold turns on more than the yes share of those voting on the question, and the model forecasts that share only

records.title: Advisory Vote No. 19 Engrossed Second Substitute Senate Bill 6269
records.why_not: the results page prints no mark on its totals. The site's index page says 'Election results are certified by each county on November 27, 2018. The Secretary of State certifies final results by December 6, 2018.' and 'The results posted before certification are unofficial.', and the measure's page was last updated '11/27/2018 4:27 PM', so its totals are likely the certified ones [inferred]. The Secretary of State's 2018 general election data download (2018-general-data.zip, its 'FINAL 2018Gen - Cong by District.pdf') prints the same statewide total, also unmarked; no certified canvass of 2018 was found on the Secretary of State's results pages. Under the ruling MEDSL's counts stand.
